proposals_not_new_source_rules: Store exact source identity/hash, word/document.xml paragraph IDs, target object/parent identities, annotation verdict and as-of observed closed-candle evidence.
Preserve formation_at, known_at, confirmed_at and invalidated_at separately; later annotation or reaction knowledge must not be backdated to an earlier formation.
A source-linked human annotation may attest a qualitative predicate; an annotation is not a numeric detector or proof of unique executable strategy.

Missing source-qualified parents, ambiguous segmentation or incomplete history stay UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED. Source-qualified adverse context may produce an explicit wait condition only within its supported directional scope.
Do not promote an untested requirement or qualitative skip recommendation into an exact invalidation event unless source provides that lifecycle.
Keep trade_entry_allowed=false; a valid object or qualitative evidence record does not unlock execution.

evidence.short_quote_ru: . EQH/EQL необязательно должны быть ровными как по линейке. Допускается отклонение в наклоне (в пределах разумного). Этот наклон должен соответствовать правилу: Для EQH - левый максимум выше правого. Для EQL - левый минимум ниже правого. (показано на схематическом и графическом примере выше).

review_flags.detail: The wording says EQH/EQL below entry, without a complete directional mapping. Preserve the quote and require priority-source/context review.
Sweep-candle close is below/above; next open is below only. Do not silently mirror or encode a one-sided condition for both directions.
Compare SW10 directional anchor and aggressive/conservative entry descriptions to Methodichka. This report does not select an interpretation or override the current frontier.
Any-timeframe scope plus H1 preference does not identify a hard H1 gate or unique context selector.
Meaningful liquidity does not establish which pool will be sought or whether a sweep fuels continuation or reversal.
Untested is explicit; exact test geometry, expiry and invalidation-time semantics are not.
